title: Count Elements With at Least K Greater Values
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, identify and count the elements that have at least k other elements in the array strictly greater than them.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, identify and count the elements that have at least k other elements in the array strictly greater than them.
constraints: nums contains up to 100,000 positive integers and 0≤k<n.
An occurrence qualifies only when at least k other occurrences have strictly greater values.
Return the number of qualified occurrences.
hints: For k>0, an occurrence qualifies exactly when it is below the kth-largest occurrence value.
Sort the array and read the value at index n-k as the strict threshold.
Count sorted values strictly smaller than that threshold; for k=0 every occurrence qualifies.
At least k positions lie at or above the threshold, and strict comparison correctly excludes ties that are not greater.
editorial: At least k positions lie at or above the threshold, and strict comparison correctly excludes ties that are not greater.

tests.explanation: Values one and two each have a larger element, so two qualify.
No value has any strictly larger occurrence, so none qualify.
